title: tenshi · The week
description: A week of nights out in tenshi, from Tiger Data.

list.name: person
list.label: Person
list.query: SELECT DISTINCT user_name FROM sessions WHERE checkin_every_s >= 300 ORDER BY 1

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.armed_at AS time, count(*) OVER (ORDER BY s.armed_at) AS value FROM sessions s WHERE s.user_name = '$person' AND s.checkin_every_s >= 300 AND $__timeFilter(s.armed_at) ORDER BY 1

SELECT s.armed_at AS time, sum(EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM coalesce(resolved_at, now()) - armed_at) / 3600) OVER (ORDER BY s.armed_at) AS value FROM sessions s WHERE s.user_name = '$person' AND s.checkin_every_s >= 300 AND $__timeFilter(s.armed_at) ORDER BY 1

SELECT 100.0 * count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.kind = 'checkin_ack') / NULLIF(count(*) FILTER (WHERE e.kind = 'checkin_sent'), 0) AS value FROM events e JOIN sessions s ON s.id = e.session_id WHERE s.user_name = '$person' AND s.checkin_every_s >= 300 AND $__timeFilter(e.time)

SELECT s.armed_at AS time, avg(m.value) AS value FROM metrics m JOIN sessions s ON s.id = m.session_id WHERE s.user_name = '$person' AND s.checkin_every_s >= 300 AND m.metric = 'reply_s' AND $__timeFilter(m.time) GROUP BY s.id, s.armed_at ORDER BY 1

panels.description: Missed check-ins that set the phone's alarm off.

targets.rawSql: SELECT count(*) AS value FROM events e JOIN sessions s ON s.id = e.session_id WHERE s.user_name = '$person' AND s.checkin_every_s >= 300 AND e.kind = 'level_change' AND e.detail->>'to' = 'ALARM' AND $__timeFilter(e.time)

panels.description: Every heartbeat, metric and event this week, in the events and metrics hypertables.

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.armed_at AS time, sum((SELECT count(*) FROM metrics WHERE session_id = s.id) + (SELECT count(*) FROM events WHERE session_id = s.id)) OVER (ORDER BY s.armed_at) AS value FROM sessions s WHERE s.user_name = '$person' AND s.checkin_every_s >= 300 AND $__timeFilter(s.armed_at) ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Where the nights went
panels.description: Heartbeat locations from every night, five-minute averages.

targets.rawSql: SELECT time_bucket('5 minutes', e.time) AS time, avg(e.lat) AS latitude, avg(e.lng) AS longitude FROM events e JOIN sessions s ON s.id = e.session_id WHERE s.user_name = '$person' AND s.checkin_every_s >= 300 AND e.kind = 'heartbeat' AND e.lat IS NOT NULL AND $__timeFilter(e.time) GROUP BY 1, s.id ORDER BY 1

panels.title: How fast she answered
panels.description: Every check-in this week by reply time. Slow replies make the next one come sooner.

targets.rawSql: SELECT CASE WHEN m.value < 5 THEN 'Under 5 s' WHEN m.value < 15 THEN '5 to 15 s' WHEN m.value < 30 THEN '15 to 30 s' ELSE 'Over 30 s' END AS "reply", count(*) AS "check-ins" FROM metrics m JOIN sessions s ON s.id = m.session_id WHERE s.user_name = '$person' AND s.checkin_every_s >= 300 AND m.metric = 'reply_s' AND $__timeFilter(m.time) GROUP BY 1 ORDER BY min(m.value)

panels.title: Battery when she got home
panels.description: Red under 20%: a dead phone looks like silence.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char(s.armed_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Toronto', 'Dy DD') AS "night", (SELECT value FROM metrics WHERE session_id = s.id AND metric = 'battery_pct' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1) AS "Battery" FROM sessions s WHERE s.user_name = '$person' AND s.checkin_every_s >= 300 AND $__timeFilter(s.armed_at) ORDER BY s.armed_at

SELECT e.time, e.detail->>'to' AS "level" FROM events e JOIN sessions s ON s.id = e.session_id WHERE s.user_name = '$person' AND s.checkin_every_s >= 300 AND e.kind = 'level_change' AND $__timeFilter(e.time) ORDER BY e.time

panels.title: Loudness by hour of the night (dB)
panels.description: Each cell averages the minute rollups (the metrics_1m continuous aggregate) for that hour. Brighter means louder.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char((m.bucket AT TIME ZONE 'America/Toronto' - interval '12 hours')::date, 'Dy Mon DD') AS "Night", round(avg(m.avg) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM m.bucket AT TIME ZONE 'America/Toronto') = 21)::numeric, 0) AS "9 PM", round(avg(m.avg) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM m.bucket AT TIME ZONE 'America/Toronto') = 22)::numeric, 0) AS "10 PM", round(avg(m.avg) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM m.bucket AT TIME ZONE 'America/Toronto') = 23)::numeric, 0) AS "11 PM", round(avg(m.avg) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM m.bucket AT TIME ZONE 'America/Toronto') = 0)::numeric, 0) AS "12 AM", round(avg(m.avg) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM m.bucket AT TIME ZONE 'America/Toronto') = 1)::numeric, 0) AS "1 AM", round(avg(m.avg) FILTER (WHERE extract(hour FROM m.bucket AT TIME ZONE 'America/Toronto') = 2)::numeric, 0) AS "2 AM" FROM metrics_1m m JOIN sessions s ON s.id = m.session_id WHERE s.user_name = '$person' AND s.checkin_every_s >= 300 AND m.metric = 'sound_db' AND $__timeFilter(m.bucket) GROUP BY (m.bucket AT TIME ZONE 'America/Toronto' - interval '12 hours')::date ORDER BY (m.bucket AT TIME ZONE 'America/Toronto' - interval '12 hours')::date DESC

panels.title: How loud each hour gets

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char(make_time(h::int, 0, 0), 'HH12 AM') AS "hour", round((avg_db + 60)::numeric, 1) AS "Loudness" FROM ( SELECT extract(hour FROM m.bucket AT TIME ZONE 'America/Toronto') AS h, avg(m.avg) AS avg_db FROM metrics_1m m JOIN sessions s ON s.id = m.session_id WHERE s.user_name = '$person' AND s.checkin_every_s >= 300 AND m.metric = 'sound_db' AND $__timeFilter(m.bucket) GROUP BY 1) x ORDER BY (h + 12)::int % 24

panels.description: Average dB above a quiet room (-60 dB), by hour.

targets.rawSql: SELECT s.armed_at AS time, avg(m.value) AS "average", max(m.value) AS "slowest" FROM metrics m JOIN sessions s ON s.id = m.session_id WHERE s.user_name = '$person' AND s.checkin_every_s >= 300 AND m.metric = 'reply_s' AND $__timeFilter(m.time) GROUP BY s.id, s.armed_at ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Coldest walk home (the Switch)
panels.description: Blue at 5°C or colder: likely outside in the cold.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char(s.armed_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Toronto', 'Dy DD') AS "night", round(min(m.value)::numeric, 1) AS "Coldest" FROM metrics m JOIN sessions s ON s.id = m.session_id WHERE s.user_name = '$person' AND s.checkin_every_s >= 300 AND m.metric = 'temp_c' AND $__timeFilter(m.time) GROUP BY s.id, s.armed_at ORDER BY s.armed_at

panels.title: Loudest moment each night
panels.description: Peak dB above a quiet room. Red is shouting territory.

targets.rawSql: SELECT to_char(s.armed_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Toronto', 'Dy DD') AS "night", round((max(m.max) + 60)::numeric) AS "Loudest" FROM metrics_1m m JOIN sessions s ON s.id = m.session_id WHERE s.user_name = '$person' AND s.checkin_every_s >= 300 AND m.metric = 'sound_peak_db' AND $__timeFilter(m.bucket) GROUP BY s.id, s.armed_at ORDER BY s.armed_at

SELECT to_char(s.armed_at AT TIME ZONE 'America/Toronto', 'Dy Mon DD, HH12:MI AM') AS "Night", round((EXTRACT(EPOCH FROM coalesce(s.resolved_at, now()) - s.armed_at) / 3600)::numeric, 1) AS "Hours", (SELECT count(*) FROM events e WHERE e.session_id = s.id AND e.kind = 'checkin_ack') AS "Check-ins", (SELECT round(avg(value)::numeric, 1) FROM metrics WHERE session_id = s.id AND metric = 'reply_s') AS "Avg reply (s)", (SELECT count(*) FROM events e WHERE e.session_id = s.id AND e.kind = 'level_change' AND e.detail->>'to' = 'ALARM') AS "Alarms", (SELECT round(max(value)::numeric, 1) FROM metrics WHERE session_id = s.id AND metric = 'distress_score') AS "Danger score", (SELECT round(min(value)::numeric, 1) FROM metrics WHERE session_id = s.id AND metric = 'temp_c') AS "Coldest (°C)", (SELECT value FROM metrics WHERE session_id = s.id AND metric = 'battery_pct' ORDER BY time DESC LIMIT 1) AS "Battery home (%)" FROM sessions s WHERE s.user_name = '$person' AND s.checkin_every_s >= 300 AND $__timeFilter(s.armed_at) ORDER BY s.armed_at DESC
